findings.title: RaBitQ32 96-to-32 dimension reduction unspecified
findings.evidence: No 32-dim rule; HR table names TOP32_RABITQ32 (89d3169) i.e. the anti-optimal selection (R2A TOP48-RAND48 ≈ -12pp; R2C TOP80-BOT80 ≈ -3.5pp); centering/query path unnamed; Codex P1 warned never-silently-choose-top32.
findings.required_fix: Freeze exact 32-dim construction + centering rule + query path; justify TOP32 if kept.

findings.title: No scoring estimator fixed for RaBitQ/PQ arms
findings.evidence: Frozen eval scores integer Hamming with 20-trial lexsort tie-breaks (probe.py:136-137); RaBitQ asymmetric float estimator and PQ ADC have no formula, no float-query spec, no symmetric-vs-ADC choice, no K=3-on-floats or epsilon rule.
findings.required_fix: Per-family frozen estimator + call sequence + float tie/epsilon rule + K=3 semantics + fairness/invariance statement.

findings.title: Primary estimand conflates vs-best with vs-mean
findings.evidence: Gap-to-best (max statistic, null -1.62/-1.20pp) vs mean-of-gaps conflated; best-scope unstated; widths pooled; bootstrap re-selection unstated (Deney-1 re-selected inside resample per RUN_LOG).
findings.required_fix: Exact formula: per-(family×width) table + one named primary; exclude per-question oracle; re-select argmax inside resample; freeze B+seeds.

findings.title: Bands uncalibrated for max statistic; no multiplicity control; incomplete decision table
findings.evidence: Null arm reads -1.6pp outside ±0.5pp parity band; kill line 2.0pp is 0.09pp above null max +1.91; ~27 looks/bench OR-kill with no family-wise control; 16 band×bench cells map to 2 actions; point-vs-CI, failure-null, and curve-dominance undefined; §6 misquotes m1 2.6pp as 3pp.
findings.required_fix: Extend m1 null to sealed set; calibrate bands; family-wise rule; complete 16-cell table with point-vs-interval rule; define dominance; fix figure.

findings.title: Third-party arms lack constructors, determinism, failure policy
findings.evidence: No faiss class/args/rotation seeds/panels; OPQ-vs-plain unchosen (HR: OPQ_PQ96; Codex P2: plain-in); no RNG/iteration/thread pins; observed IndexPQ(96,12,8).train FAIL at n=50 / OK at 300; LoCoMo min-N unevidenced; no fallback (Codex P2 no-fallback policy open).
findings.required_fix: Exact constructors+seeds+panels; determinism pins; fallback rule; faiss version+wheel hash.

findings.title: Byte worksheet not operative
findings.evidence: No declared/measured method; no code_size-vs-serialization tie-break; shared state unlisted (mu 768B/archive; PQ codebooks 98304B/archive ≈ 200B/vec at N=490); subset index sets unruled; LUT status unstated; effective cost undefined/homeless.
findings.required_fix: Worksheet table + disagreement rule + amortized cost as primary-table column + dual-axis curve.

findings.title: No sealable run package
findings.evidence: No runner command/paths (harness hardcodes C:/ path deney1_lme.py:15); no manifest; analysis unfrozen; stop rules beyond aborts absent; certified-matrices/cohort hashes unnamed; no-reseed rule absent; no seal-hash binding.
findings.required_fix: Run plan + manifest + frozen analysis + stop rules + provenance + amendment/no-reseed policy + seal binding; then HR sign.

findings.title: Disclosure omits outcomes and race NOES licenses
findings.evidence: Race introduces alternate distance metrics (NORES class) without licensing them; c2/m2/m3 negative outcomes undisclosed; Design-1 gate exploratory status undisclosed; SPREAD-cap erratum unnamed; §6 numbers uncited.
findings.required_fix: Extend boilerplate (license estimators; add outcomes; gate status; name errata); cite every §6 number.

findings.title: LoCoMo-only BOT arm: asymmetric bar
findings.evidence: R2C justifies (BOT80 -0.1pp) but widths/seeds/panel unstated and stricter-LoCoMo-bar unacknowledged.
findings.required_fix: Specify construction; acknowledge asymmetry or justify.

findings.title: Width mapping and panels implicit; fixed-vs-max disadvantage missing
findings.evidence: bytes↔bits↔width_idx table absent; ≥7 vs Deney-1 10 unjustified (prefer 10 given 3.34pp range); SPREAD single-vs-panel unstated; ROUND3 C2/C3 vs-mean co-report language absent.
findings.required_fix: Explicit mapping; justify seed count; state SPREAD shape; carry C2/C3 language.

findings.required_fix: Re-ground in pinned API; keep code_size abort.
